name: bb10-volte
scope: Rooted SQC100-2 and SQW100-4 on OS 10.3.3.3216. Q20/Unicom and Passport/Mobile full restore, uninstall, reinstall, calls and SMS accepted with mobile 0.1.0.12 and service r18; Q20/Mobile and Passport/Unicom SIM swaps accepted. This release preserves r18 wireless payload bytes and adds the mobile project/support sheet, progress feedback and bundled desktop BAR provisioning. Version 0.1.0.15 build and package validation do not substitute for new device acceptance. Q10 native installation remains under separate testing and is not admitted by this release. Historical desktop and experimental variant capabilities remain documented separately.
